changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Adds the sidedness of a linear action code, set from actions_sidedness.csv. No default: NULL means never set, which the length calculation treats as both-sides.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE actions ADD COLUMN sidedness TEXT CONSTRAINT actions_sidedness_check CHECK (sidedness IN ('single-side', 'both-sides'));
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE actions DROP COLUMN sidedness;
